fullPassage: Where is all the tourist money going? It is apparent from reviewing worldwide travel patterns that tourism remains an economic activity that primarily benefits developed countries. Travel today from Europe to North America and vice versa accounts for approximately 79% of all travellers and 78% of all tourism receipts. A few countries in Asia, in particular Japan, have entered the picture as major recipients and generators of tourists. In most cases, tourism growth is tied to level of economic growth. Those countries that show economic growth are most likely to be the ones to generate and benefit from tourism. Countries in Africa and South America, with few exceptions, are not yet major tourism generators or receivers. For example, Africa, which has great resource wealth, especially in primary commodities such as timber, gold, and tropical agricultural products, attracts only 4% of all world travellers. Given Africa's growing population, its tourism adds very little to the Gross National Product (GNP) of many countries.

❌ ③ (B)는 '계좌'가 아니라 '설명하다'
❌ ④ 순서가 뒤바뀜
det.tip: account for: 수치 뒤에 오면 '차지하다', 원인 뒤에 오면 '설명하다'

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "raw materials or primary agricultural products that can be bought and sold, such as timber or gold"

det.korean: commodities = 상품들, 원자재 (사고팔 수 있는 원자재나 1차 농산물, 예: 목재, 금).
det.analysis:
❌ ① receipts(영수증/수입): 거래 증빙 또는 수입금으로 원자재 정의와 불일치
❌ ② exceptions(예외): 규칙에서 벗어난 사례로 원자재와 무관
❌ ③ generators(발생시키는 것): 만들어 내는 주체로 원자재 정의와 무관
✅ ④ commodities(상품): 목재, 금처럼 사고팔 수 있는 원자재/1차 상품이라는 정의에 정확히 부합

questions.passage: It is apparent from reviewing worldwide travel patterns that tourism remains an economic activity that primarily benefits __________ (develop) countries. Travel today from Europe to North America and vice versa accounts for approximately 79% of all travellers.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

develop → ____

det.korean: 관광은 주로 '선진' 국가에 이득이 된다.
det.analysis: 명사 countries를 수식하는 형용사 자리. 동사 develop을 과거분사(형용사 용법) developed로 변환해 '발전된(=선진의)' 국가라는 의미를 만든다.
det.tip: develop의 과거분사 developed가 형용사로 '선진의, 발전된'의 뜻

questions.passage: For example, Africa, which has great resource wealth, especially in primary commodities such as timber, gold, and tropical agricultural products, attracts only 4% of all world travellers. Given Africa's __________ (grow) population, its tourism adds very little to the Gross National Product (GNP) of many countries.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

grow → ____

det.korean: 아프리카의 '증가하는' 인구를 고려할 때, 관광이 GNP에 거의 보태지 못한다.
det.analysis: 명사 population을 수식하는 형용사 자리. 진행/지속의 의미로 현재분사 growing이 필요. '증가하고 있는 인구'라는 능동 의미이므로 growing(현재분사)으로 변환.
det.tip: grow의 현재분사 growing이 형용사로 '증가하는, 커지는'의 뜻

questions.passage: Where is all the tourist money going? It is apparent from reviewing worldwide travel patterns that tourism remains an economic activity that primarily benefits developed countries. Travel today from Europe to North America and vice versa accounts for approximately 79% of all travellers and 78% of all tourism receipts. A few countries in Asia, in particular Japan, have entered the picture as __________ and generators of tourists. In most cases, tourism growth is tied to level of economic growth. Those countries that show economic growth are most likely to be the ones to generate and benefit from tourism. Countries in Africa and South America, with few exceptions, are not yet major tourism generators or receivers. For example, Africa, which has great resource wealth, especially in primary commodities such as timber, gold, and tropical agricultural products, attracts only 4% of all world travellers. Given Africa's growing population, its tourism adds very little to the Gross National Product (GNP) of many countries.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주요 수취국(major recipients). 아시아의 몇몇 국가, 특히 일본이 관광객의 '주요 수취국'이자 발생국으로 등장했다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① major recipients(주요 수취국): 'entered the picture as ____ and generators of tourists'. 'generators'와 짝을 이루는 상위 개념
❌ ② economic growth(경제 성장): 글의 다른 지점(관광 성장의 원인)에서 쓰이는 표현으로 이 자리에 부적합
❌ ③ tourism receipts(관광 수입): '여행자 수'가 아닌 금전 수입 개념으로 generators와 병치되지 않음
❌ ④ resource wealth(자원의 부): 아프리카 예시 대목에서 쓰이는 표현으로 일본·아시아 문맥과 불일치
det.tip: major recipients = 주요 수취국 (관광객을 받는 쪽)

questions.passage: Where is all the tourist money going? It is apparent from reviewing worldwide travel patterns that tourism remains an economic activity that primarily benefits __________. Travel today from Europe to North America and vice versa accounts for approximately 79% of all travellers and 78% of all tourism receipts. A few countries in Asia, in particular Japan, have entered the picture as major recipients and generators of tourists. In most cases, tourism growth is tied to level of economic growth. Those countries that show economic growth are most likely to be the ones to generate and benefit from tourism. Countries in Africa and South America, with few exceptions, are not yet major tourism generators or receivers. For example, Africa, which has great resource wealth, especially in primary commodities such as timber, gold, and tropical agricultural products, attracts only 4% of all world travellers. Given Africa's growing population, its tourism adds very little to the Gross National Product (GNP) of many countries.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선진국(developed countries). 관광이 주로 '선진국'에 이득을 준다는 글 전체의 주제 명사구.
det.analysis:
❌ ① tropical agricultural products(열대 농산물): 아프리카 예시의 세부로 글 전체 주제가 아님
❌ ② tourism growth(관광 성장): 경제 성장과 연결되는 변수이지 이득 받는 주체가 아님
❌ ③ primary commodities(1차 상품): 아프리카 자원 예시의 세부로 전체 주제가 아님
✅ ④ developed countries(선진국): 'tourism ... primarily benefits ____'. 글 전체 결론을 요약하는 주제어
det.tip: developed countries = 선진국 (글 전체의 핵심 주제어)
